veranderings.blok: Water wat by die huis vuil word
veranderings.voor: onsself en ons klere en skottelgoed
veranderings.rede: A list of three reads more clearly with a comma than with a repeated 'en', and it saves a word.

veranderings.voor: om produkte te maak en hul afvalwater
veranderings.na: om produkte te maak, en hul afvalwater
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('Fabrieke gebruik' / 'hul afvalwater kan bevat'), so a comma is needed.

veranderings.voor: van huise en fabrieke en plase
veranderings.rede: A list of three takes a comma rather than a repeated 'en'; saves a word.

veranderings.voor: voordat dit terug na 'n rivier of 'n ander waterbron gaan
veranderings.na: voordat dit na 'n rivier of 'n ander waterbron teruggaan
veranderings.rede: The separable verb 'teruggaan' belongs together at the end of the subordinate clause, as in the glossary definition; saves a word.

veranderings.voor: In groot tenks sak die swaar vuiligheid daarna stadig
veranderings.na: Daarna sak die swaar vuiligheid in groot tenks stadig
veranderings.rede: In a step-by-step sequence the sequence word reads more naturally at the start of the sentence; no words added.

veranderings.blok: Beter om water skoon te hou
veranderings.voor: om water nie in die eerste plek te besoedel nie
veranderings.na: om te verhoed dat water besoedel word
veranderings.rede: 'In die eerste plek' means 'firstly' in Afrikaans; 'in the first place' (to begin with) is better said as preventing pollution, keeping 'besoedel' and saving three words.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: This entry lists 'bakterieë' under NIE, while a separate entry protects 'bakterieë' itself (HOU) for this sub-topic. The lesson uses bare 'bakterieë' correctly in the heading, in 'Helder water kan dus steeds bakterieë bevat wat mense siek kan maak' (restricted by the relative clause) and in 'Nuttige bakterieë'; nothing was changed, but a person may want to reconcile the two entries.
